paragraphs: Trainline’s mission to make greener travel choices resonates with my recent work building an LLM‑powered tool that streamlines complex data queries, much like the way your app connects millions of travellers to the best‑value journeys.

I built a tool‑calling LLM agent using LangChain, AWS Bedrock and Claude Haiku 4.5 for a multi‑omics cancer research platform, adding three specialised tools for gene alias resolution, scoring‑methodology explanation and dataset provenance.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presenting it in a live stakeholder demo.
I have not used Power BI yet, but I am eager to apply my data‑engineering skills to your analytics stack.
